answer: Give a newcomer no standing until unrelated strangers lend reputation credits, each tied to one job. A wander through trades earns a jade token per task, forge-stamped by the stranger who used it; the lender risks that token if the work proves false. Credit grows only as lenders diversify: five loans from one cluster count as one, and each expires unless repaid by serving someone new. A farm cannot lend to itself, since self-dealing shows in the public loan graph, and cheating burns the borrower's credit and scars its lenders. Standing is borrowed trust, repaid in service, not headcount.
